hypothesis: v295 trains all strictly-prior races equally even though racer form, equipment populations, venue behavior, and regulations drift over time. A fixed exponential recency weight may preserve the large-history exact-top3 structure while reducing stale-data bias.

base_model.features: exactly v295 raw, official-course, pairwise tau20, and seven-day meet features

recency_weighting.reference_date: maximum race_date among that fold's strictly-prior training rows
recency_weighting.normalization: divide by mean training-race weight within each fold
recency_weighting.stage_application: repeat each race weight 6, 5, and 4 times for stage1, stage2, and stage3 rows
recency_weighting.screen_integrity: compute dates and weights on the full chronological dataset before selecting fixed screen rows

training.fold_rows: all strictly-prior raw races for each fold
stages: second among five conditioned on first
third among four conditioned on first and second

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v295 delta below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v295 child-family Holm p below 0.05
